notes.title: 2.0.4 Patch update notice
notes.content:
Attention Ultra Age fans!

2.0.4 patch has updated to improve game stability and convenience in DLC 'Rebirth Project'.
Please play the game after update to latest version.

2.0.4 Patchnote
- Main game
[list]
[*]Optimizing resources for more smooth playing
[*]Fix known minor issues
[/list]
- DLC 'Rebirth Project'
[list]
[*]We have eased the prerequisite conditions for the content so that more people can enjoy it.
From now, any players can be played the 'Rebirth Project' although not proceeding the main game.
Please enjoy Ultra Age style rogue-like gameplay and escape the lab!
Note: Installing the additional content has still required.
[/list]

Please enjoy!

notes.title: Free DLC 'Rebirth Project' released today!
notes.content:
Attention Ultra Age fans!

Ultra Age's additional content [b]'Rebirth Project'[/b] has released today.

[list]
[*][h3]Introducing[/h3]
Age was exploring a portal in the Frontier Shelter when he was suddenly moved to what appears to be a laboratory by an unknown force. It seems to be a laboratory of the Frontier meant for testing creatures, filled with many devices to measure and record combat capabilities and strengthen their shortcomings.  All experimental subjects created from these repeated experiments are beings who seek perfection, created solely from data.

Age becomes a reincarnation constantly reborn by Helvis in the laboratory each time a 'different Age' participates in an experiment... An experiment that cannot be escaped until it is fully completed. Will Age be able to escape from the 'Rebirth Project'?
[/list]

This DLC is free, so all players can experience the Ultra Age style rogue-like level.

[b]Note[/b]
The game itself has also updated. If you didn't see DLC menu although the game cleared, please update the game.

Please enjoy!

notes.title: Free DLC 'Rebirth Project' is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Attention Ultra Age fans!

Ultra Age's additional content [b]'Rebirth Project'[/b] is coming soon.
This content adds a rogue-like level, accessible from the new menu in the title screen.
(Note: You will need to proceed in the game until a certain chapter to activate the DLC.)
In this content, you will find familiar monsters, including bosses that you met in the main game, as well as some new enemies.
Bring many blades with new mechanics to bear! Survive the enemy waves and overcome their onslaught!

This DLC is free, so all players can experience the Ultra Age style rogue-like level.

Release dates/times will be follow:
[list]
[*]9/19, 5:00 pm GMT (UTC +0)
[*]9/19, 10:00 am PDT
[*]9/19, 7:00 pm CEST
[*]9/20, 2:00 am KST/JST
[/list]
(Release times may be changed.)

We're looking forward to sharing this with you!
